name: Wasteland Surge: Storm-Chase Experience Operators
description: A cluster of licensed and unlicensed operators running guided storm-chase excursions into the climate-volatile Wastes beyond GLMZ's atmospheric management perimeter, where mega-cell thunderstorms, dust walls, and electromagnetic surge events create landscapes of violent, unmediated natural spectacle. Clients are transported in hardened crawler vehicles with BCI-linked environmental feeds, pursuing storm fronts across the outer Great Lakes corridor for immersive proximity experiences. Licensed operators maintain safety margins and emergency extraction; unlicensed 'surge runners' sell proximity packages that bring clients inside the storm envelope.
story_hooks: A character hired as a surge runner guide discovers their latest group of clients is not tourists — they're using the storm excursion as cover for a covert operation in the Wastes.

A massive electromagnetic surge event near the city perimeter produces anomalous BCI interference patterns that appear to encode a structured signal — and the only people who witnessed it are a storm-chase group with conflicting accounts.
A Tier 4 client survives a catastrophic surge event and returns changed — with sensory perceptions and knowledge they cannot account for, and a compulsion to go back into the storm.
